title: Dinosaur Stomp ABC
hook: Stomp the letter, name the clue!
A to Z, the past comes through!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D dinosaur storybook, earthy greens and amber, rounded non-scary dinosaurs, museum-clean silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 alternates stomp-sized short entries with longer fossil or body-shape clues; do not call every prehistoric animal a dinosaur when it is a pterosaur or marine reptile.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses footprint-sized recall gaps followed by object-conditioned morphology gestures: plates, armor, horns, crests, long necks, sickle claws, pterosaur wings, marine swimming, nest/fossil shapes, or body-size silhouettes. Use a plain trace/stomp only when no clearer clue exists.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a low soft tom footprint followed by one dry woodblock click.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a low soft tom footprint followed by one dry woodblock click
